description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, including several asynchronous methods related to retrieving and setting linked grain references, as well as a serializable class that holds a grain reference.

classes.name: ChainGrainHolder
classes.description: A serializable container class for holding a reference to an IChainedGrain.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the grain.

methods.name: GetX
methods.description: Retrieves a specific value or coordinate associated with the grain.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: GetCalculatedValue
methods.description: Calculates and returns a value based on grain data.

methods.name: SetNext
methods.description: Sets the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: SetNextNested
methods.description: Sets the next grain using a nested holder.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the state possibly based on whether the next is set.

methods.name: PassThis
methods.description: Passes a reference to this grain to another grain.

methods.name: PassThisNested
methods.description: Passes a nested holder containing this grain.

methods.name: PassNullNested
methods.description: Passes a nested holder with null.
